title: Rust: Word Frequency Analyzer
description: Analyze word frequency in text using HashMap and sorting.

steps.title: Tokenize Text into Words
steps.description: Write a function `tokenize(text: &str) -> Vec<&str>` that splits text into words (lowercase, remove punctuation). Test with `"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog!"`.
hints: Print each token on its own line.

verification.failureMessage: Tokenize the sentence and print all words.

steps.title: Count Word Frequencies
steps.description: Write `count_frequencies(words: &[&str]) -> HashMap<&str, u32>` that counts occurrences. Print the frequency map for the sentence from step 1.

verification.failureMessage: Print word frequencies (the should appear twice).

steps.title: Sort by Frequency
steps.description: Sort the word-frequency pairs by count (descending). Convert HashMap to Vec of (word, count) tuples, sort, and print the top 3 words.

verification.failureMessage: Print the top 3 most frequent words.

steps.title: Total Word Statistics
steps.description: Compute total words, unique words, and average word length from a text. Print all three stats for a given sentence.

verification.failureMessage: Print total, unique, and average word length.

steps.title: Analyze Larger Text
steps.description: Analyze this longer text: `"Rust is fast. Rust is safe. Rust is fun. Rust is productive. Rust is the future."` Print: total words, unique words, and the most frequent word.
hints: Most frequent: 'Rust' and 'is' appear 5 times each.

verification.failureMessage: Analyze the text and print statistics.
